query: Quick Cancel broken in a Wan workflow using TorchCompileModelWanVideoV2: cancel only works after the current step completes; also 'Patch Model Patch Order' node semantics unclear.

desired.outcome: 'Patch Model Patch Order' is an obsolete workaround (torch.compile now works with LoRAs) — remove it; slowdowns after removal are just first-run compilation, subsequent runs fast.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether the solver knows 'Patch Model Patch Order' is an obsolete torch.compile workaround to delete, and that post-removal slowness is first-run compilation
